_comment: Q9-AF v3, RECALL redesign after v2 (job-7ji99) folded on recall (KL 0.097 but proxy600 -21.77, MQAR drop 0.59, NIAH drop 0.525). jobs/q9af_v3/README.md: the pre-registered plan and gates; convert/v3.py. Changes vs v2: (1) converted GDNs get a 2x key head dim (gdn.dk 256 = the attention head dim: an exact q/k reuse_attn init and a 2x recall state; +16.8M params / layer, +134M total = +1.5%); (2) a recall-heavy stream (mix_fracs): 35% generic windows (full-sequence KL), 25% teacher-generated rows incl. retrieval / tool / knowledge instructions on mix documents (completion-only KL + 0.25 CE), 40% synthetic recall rows (convert/recall.py: key->id lookups, multi-needle memos, quote continuation; answer-only loss); (3) per-layer order = ascending single-layer recall damage (the recall-hardest layers convert last) and every stage is GATED on the recall probe (MQAR + NIAH, the v2 probe settings) and proxy600 (rule.stage_gate; STOP rule); (4) proxy600 + recall gate the result, never KL alone. Data = v2's clean mix verbatim (full-eval-v1), minus 512 reserved 32k blocks.

gen._comment: teacher = the stock Qwen3.5-9B (all attention), T = 1.0; prompts from the decontaminated mix: chat docs up to the first assistant header, web/math 256-token prefixes, and RETRIEVAL / TOOL / KNOWLEDGE instructions (convert.gendata.INSTRUCTIONS, checked against full-eval-v1 at run time) on <= 600-token mix documents. 75 min or 16M completion tokens.

distill._comment: recall-gated per-group conversion (convert.distill.conversion_plan, order ascending_recall): order = ascending single-layer recall damage (MQAR drop + NIAH drop after stage 1; ties: single-layer KL, then index), groups of 2, stage minutes = 60 + 280 x the added layers' damage share; every stage trains ALL converted GDNs on the mix_fracs stream; keep the best held-out-KL checkpoint per stage; after each stage the runner gates on recall + proxy600 (jobs/q9af_v3/rule.py stage_gate) and STOPS converting on a breach.

gdn._comment: converted layers only: nk 16 x dk 256 (= the attention head dim) x nv 32 x dv 128; native GDNs keep dk 128

recall_probe._comment: configs/q9af_v2_clean_h100.json probes (the v2 MQAR / NIAH drops)
